entries.reason: The agent browser profiles hold signed-in browser sessions (cookies and site storage). Those are secrets and are bound to this machine, so they are never backed up; on a new machine the agent signs in again.

Audit journals, call records, grant stores, launch history, signed-in-domain records and the raised-card registry. Grants are machine-local by design, and the audit trail is this machine's own history, so none of it moves to another machine.
